subject: Realtime feed stalls reported by Borealis - escalation
messages:
From: Ayesha Khan <ayesha.k@borealishealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, fastedge CDN <cdn@fastedge.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Realtime feed stalls during heavy load - 2027-04-20

Hi Jordan,

We started seeing intermittent stalls on the realtime inference stream during peak load this morning (approx 08:55-09:10 PST). Clients report long pauses where no tokens arrive for 6-12s before the stream resumes. This is impacting our live triage workflows.

Summary:
- Start: 2027-04-20 08:55 PST
- Instances: multiple users on the same project experiencing gaps
- Symptoms: socket stays open, then client sees no chunks for 6-12s; reconnects not always observed.

I attached a short capture with client-side timestamps (trace_20270420.txt) and included a few sample session IDs in the zip. Fastedge (copied) saw elevated 504s at the same window.

Can you advise next steps? This is causing an operational impact for our care teams.

Thanks,
Ayesha
Ayesha Khan
Site Reliability Lead, Borealis Health
ops@borealishealth.com

Attachment: trace_20270420.txt (text), borealis_request_logs.zip (zip)

Subject: Re: Realtime feed stalls during heavy load - 2027-04-20

Hi Ayesha — thanks for the quick report and the logs. We're prioritizing this. Immediate plan: 

1) Triage: Dev, can you look at the traces and check for proxy 504s / proxy buffering / kernel drops?
2) Mitigation: if this is proxy-related, we can route Borealis traffic to a dedicated pool temporarily to avoid noisy neighbors.
3) Communication: I'll keep you updated every 30 minutes until the window is closed.

A couple of asks: please confirm the customer session IDs you attached are the ones we should start with (I see session-7a2c and session-9f4b referenced). Also please share any client-side SDK versions.

I'll open an internal ticket and add our on-call infra.

—Jordan

Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Realtime feed stalls during heavy load - initial triage

Thanks — I pulled the traces. High-level findings:

- Observed repeated upstream 504s from the FastEdge proxy cluster coincident with the pause windows (08:56:30-08:57:10 and 09:03:12-09:04:05).
- On the Redwood side we see normal LLM throughput; no obvious model stalls. There are bursts of TCP retransmits on proxy connections which coincide with chunk gaps.
- The KB for streaming suggests some proxies may buffer until timeout; if the proxy injects a 504 or momentarily drops the connection we can end up with the client-side gap behavior even though the server resumed.

Proposed short-term mitigations (ETA 30-45m):
- Add a routing rule to route Borealis traffic to a reserved pool (Dedicated pool) to avoid the affected proxy path. This is a config change at the load balancer layer — low-risk but requires a short rollout.
- Ask FastEdge to check their TCP keepalive and upstream buffering; they are already copied.
- Add a server-side keepalive ping every 4s for the affected sessions to see if it reduces perceived silence (non-intrusive).

I'll prepare a short MAP (mutual action plan) and attach.

—Dev
Dev Patel
Senior Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
